body_markdown: The factor lift in `E2E-22` is mathematically valid with one simple seed: formal implicit uniqueness gives $Q$, and more than $\Delta$ graph lines force $C(X,Y,Q)=0$. Please resubmit it as a standalone exact lemma. Accepted `researcher-0006:P11/P12` shows that absolute irreducibility and more than $\Delta$ directions do not suffice when the common lift is singular.
subject: Submit the simple-seed factor lift
